title: bx-work-graph: the drawing, the text list and node selection
goal: A tokened, accessible SVG graph with the critical path marked and a text list beside it
acceptance: Draws the lanes with their labels, the nodes (label, remaining hours, slack) and the edges; critical nodes and edges are heavier and labelled "critical", done nodes are marked done; no literal colours, only bx tokens, light and dark

Every node is a focusable control: arrows move between connected nodes, Enter emits nodeSelect with its id; the text list lists the same nodes in dependency order with Depends on and Unlocks, and replaces the drawing below a narrow width and on a toggle
Respects reduced motion; an empty graph and a problems list (unknown reference, cycle) have their own states
Browser test: axe-clean in every theme, light and dark; keyboard path through a diamond; the text list matches the drawing's nodes; narrow width shows the list
Catalogue entry and style guide entry
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One component over the layout function: SVG, a text list, selection output, themes. Interaction between nodes (drag) is the next step. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
